title: Open Document Skills: a stdlib-only native-ODF toolkit and agent skill set (ODT/ODP/ODS/ODG)
description: Dependency-free Python toolkit for the four OpenDocument formats (ODT/ODP/ODS/ODG). The shared library is published to PyPI as open-document-lib; four agent skills (SKILL.md) let an LLM generate, edit, validate, brand, repair and convert ODF files locally, on an open ISO standard, without a proprietary office suite. Includes scholarly authoring (footnotes, BibTeX/CSL-JSON citations, cross-references, MathML), named ranges and data validation, embedded charts, connectors and shape groups, RelaxNG validation, and PDF rendering.
